name: B10-0406/2025 – § 1 – Am 1/1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the declaration of principles for a gender-equal society
part_text: 1. Reiterates and reaffirms its commitment to women’s rights and gender equality; recalls that equality is best understood as fairness of opportunity and respect for individual merit, rather than enforced parity of outcome or discriminatory quotas; respects the biological distinctions between men and women;
